name: Soil moisture sensor
summary: Soil wetness as 0-100 %, averaged to be steady, with your own dry/wet calibration. For irrigation, greenhouses and seedling trays.
parts: capacitive soil moisture sensor v1.2 (better) or resistive probe

points.note: Turns the raw reading into 0-100% using your two calibration readings, and clamps it so it never shows -5% or 110%.

points.find: for (int i = 0; i < n_; i++) sum += analogRead(pin_);
points.note: Several readings averaged: analog sensors flicker, and the average is steadier.
